variantNote: These are the South African Xitsonga month names as given in the official SA calendar/government usage (Sunguti .. N'wendzamhala). Loan forms (Janyuwari, Fevuwari, etc.) also circulate in everyday speech but the traditional set is the standard written one. No claim made about Shangani (Mozambique).
note: Machine draft from knowledge, not a fluent-speaker approval. Moderate-to-high confidence in the whole set. Mudyaxihi (May), Khotavuxika (June), Mawuwani (July), Mhawuri (Aug), Ndzhati (Sep), Nhlangula (Oct), Hukuri (Nov), N'wendzamhala (Dec) are the most widely attested. Least certain: the January-April block (Sunguti, Nyenyenyani, Nyenyankulu, Dzivamisoko); some sources shift these by one month or reverse Nyenyenyani/Nyenyankulu, so a speaker should check them. Short forms are first 3 letters, with Nyk to distinguish Nyenyankulu from Nyenyenyani and N'we for N'wendzamhala (4 chars incl. apostrophe).
